dedupe_keys.name: etude littosis reperage des profils sismiques 2013

description: Etude Littosis - repérage des profils sismiques 2013 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.picto-occitanie.fr. During the 2012 LITTOSIS mission, approximately 400 profiles were obtained over a distance of 100 km of coastal linear (Figure 5). In 2013, a second acquisition campaign completes this data with around 150 profiles. The transverse profiles at the coast are 400 m apart. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Littosis study - identification of seismic profiles 2013" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
